1.explanation: This minimal React app imports the Carbon Toggle component and renders it with custom Off/On labels.  By default, the component’s implementation (in Toggle.js) adds aria-hidden="true" to the <span> that contains the label text.  When you run this app in Safari or Chrome on macOS with VoiceOver turned on, tab to the toggle input and press Space or Enter.  VoiceOver will announce the control but will not read “On” or “Off” because those spans are hidden from screen readers.  Inspect the DOM to see the aria-hidden attributes on the label text spans.
1.bug_scenario: When you tab to the Carbon Toggle component and activate it (via Space or Enter) on macOS Mojave with VoiceOver enabled, VoiceOver does not announce the “On” or “Off” label.  Inspecting the rendered HTML shows that the two <span> elements containing the label text have aria-hidden="true" set, which hides them from screen‐readers.
